title: VTC — shared admin-invite definitions
description: Shared types for the vtc/admin/invites/* family. An admin invite is a one-shot install URL that lets a named DID enrol an administrator passkey; `create` mints one and `list` enumerates them, so the summary lives here.

InviteSummary.title: InviteSummary
InviteSummary.description: One outstanding or historical admin invite. Consumed rows are retained as audit history and cannot be revoked.

jti.description: Unique invite identifier; the revoke target.

targetDid.description: The admin DID this invite enrols a passkey for.

consumedAt.description: When the invite was redeemed, if it was.

InviteStatus.title: InviteStatus
InviteStatus.description: `issued` is outstanding and revocable; `consumed` and `expired` are terminal.
